parameters.name: CloudResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the protected resource. WAF automatically generates this ID when you add the cloud service to WAF.

> Call [CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~) to add a resource and then view the resource ID in the response.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to view the ID of your WAF instance.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the cloud service that is added to WAF.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud service instance.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceProduct
parameters.description:
The type of the cloud service. Valid values:

- **clb4**: Layer 4 CLB.

- **clb7**: Layer 7 CLB.

- **ecs**: ECS.

- **nlb**: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
